source: MaleCNS v1.0, FlyEM / Janelia / Google Research
limitations: Real neuron skeletons and measured directed synapse counts. Selected 30-neuron wing motor subgraph, not a complete brain. Stimulation, membrane dynamics, propagation timing and mapping motor activity to game forces are artificial. Motor names do not validate the game action labels. All connections treated as excitatory by the game; neurotransmitter signs are not modeled.
